answers.core:
It must be core as it is low level.  
OpenGL offers a lot of different texture types (see https://www.khronos.org/registry/OpenGL-Refpages/gl4/html/glTexImage2D.xhtml).  
I believe having just the two types RGBA and FLOAT is enough to cover most of the use cases.
answers.workaround: I currently need to pack the float into the RGBA texture and can only reach a float accuracy of 24-bits (as ALPHA channel can't be used as Godot triggers some incompatible pipeline processing if it is written).
